s5.body: Lien Parental provides a tool to support co-parenting; it is in no way a substitute for legal, medical or psychological advice. The publisher makes its best efforts to ensure the availability of the service, without however guaranteeing absolute continuity. It cannot be held liable for indirect damage or for an interruption due to force majeure.

credits.title: 6. AI credits and top-ups
credits.body: Each plan includes monthly AI credits (Free {free}, Premium {premium}, Coparentalité+ {copa}), allocated for each billing period (a monthly period from sign-up for the Free plan; for a yearly subscription, one allocation each month, not twelve at once). Unused monthly credits do not carry over: they expire at the end of the period. Beyond that, users can buy top-ups whatever their plan (including Free): {packs}. Prices include all taxes and are paid in one go through Stripe; credits are only added once Stripe has confirmed the payment. A top-up does not unlock any feature reserved for Premium or Coparentalité+ and does not change the vault capacity. The cost of each action is shown before it starts: question to the Coach {chat, plural, one {# credit} other {# credits}}, situation analysis {situation, plural, one {# credit} other {# credits}}, document analysis {document, plural, one {# credit} other {# credits}}. Monthly credits are used first, then purchased credits, starting with those that expire soonest; an action that fails uses no credits. Purchased credits are valid for {months} months from purchase and then expire without compensation; they are kept if you change plan or cancel and remain usable for their validity period. Credits are personal: they are not shared between members of a family space, cannot be transferred and cannot be converted into money. As digital content supplied immediately, users expressly request immediate access to the credits before payment and acknowledge that they lose their right of withdrawal as soon as they are first used (article L221-28 of the French Consumer Code); as long as no credit from the pack has been used, they may withdraw within fourteen days of purchase by contacting support. Used credits are non-refundable, except where required by law. If a payment is refunded or disputed, the remaining credits of the pack concerned are cancelled. Cancelling a subscription takes effect at the end of the period already paid; no new monthly allocation is made afterwards, and account data remains accessible.

s6.title: 7. Governing law
s6.body: These Terms are governed by French law. Any dispute relating to their interpretation or performance falls under the exclusive jurisdiction of the French courts, subject to the mandatory provisions applicable to consumers.

privacy.metaDescription: Lien Parental privacy policy: GDPR, data storage in the EU, processors and transfers, encryption, retention period, right to be forgotten.
privacy.title: Privacy policy

controller.title: Data controller
controller.p1: The controller of the data collected through Lien Parental is the company Pirabel Labs, whose contact details appear in the legal notice. Any question about the processing of your data can be sent to dpo@lienparental.fr.

purposes.title: Purposes and legal bases (GDPR)
purposes.p1: We process your data for: (i) providing the service and managing your account (contractual basis); (ii) improving the experience (legitimate interest, which you may object to); (iii) complying with our legal obligations, in particular regarding the retention of evidence. No processing is carried out for advertising purposes.

storage.title: Where your data is stored
storage.p1: Your data (account, children, journal, calendar, vault, testimonials, messages and files) is stored in the European Union (Ireland), in the database and storage space of our host Supabase. The application’s functions run in France (Paris).
storage.p2: Some providers, listed below, are companies based in the United States and may process part of the data outside the European Union. These transfers are only made with the appropriate safeguards provided for in articles 44 et seq. of the GDPR.

processors.title: Processors and transfers outside the EU
processors.intro: We only send each provider the data needed for the service it provides. Transfer safeguards rely on the standard contractual clauses adopted by the European Commission, included in each provider’s data processing agreement, where applicable supplemented by its participation in the EU-U.S. Data Privacy Framework.
processors.outro: The up-to-date list of processors can be obtained on request from dpo@lienparental.fr.
processors.scc: European Commission standard contractual clauses (provider’s data processing agreement), where applicable supplemented by the EU-U.S. Data Privacy Framework.

supabase.name: Supabase (database, accounts, files)
supabase.purpose: Database hosting, authentication and file storage.
supabase.data: All the data in your space: account, children, journal, calendar, vault, testimonials, messages and files.
supabase.location: European Union (Ireland). Supabase is an American company: occasional access from outside the EU (support, maintenance) remains possible.

vercel.name: Vercel (application hosting)
vercel.purpose: Running the web application and serving pages and static files.
vercel.data: Technical request data (IP address, pages visited, browser) and data in transit while using the service.
vercel.location: Functions run in the European Union (Paris). Vercel is an American company with a global delivery network: a request may pass through a point of presence near you, including outside the EU.

anthropic.name: Anthropic (AI Coach)
anthropic.purpose: AI Coach answers and analysis of the messages you submit to it.
anthropic.data: Only when you use the Coach: your question or the content to analyze, and a summary of your space (children’s first names and ages, journal, calendar, document names). Medical information is only sent if you enable it for a question.
anthropic.location: United States (Anthropic is an American company).

stripe.name: Stripe (payments)
stripe.purpose: Payment and management of subscriptions, invoices.
stripe.data: Email address, account ID, chosen plan, and payment data entered directly on Stripe’s pages (we never see your card number).
stripe.location: European Union and United States (Stripe is an American group).

resend.name: Resend (sending emails)
resend.purpose: Sending the service’s emails: account confirmation, security, invitations, testimonials, invoices.
resend.data: Recipient’s email address and email content (first names, links).
resend.location: United States (Resend is an American company).

google.name: Google (sign-in and Google Calendar, only if you choose them)
google.purpose: Sign-in with your Google account and, if you enable it, copying your events to your Google Calendar.
google.data: Sign-in: name, email address and Google ID. Calendar: title, dates and location of copied events (health appointments hidden by default, children’s first names never sent).
google.location: European Union and United States. For your Google account data, Google acts under its own privacy rules.

google.title: Data received from Google
google.p1: If you choose “Continue with Google”, Lien Parental receives from Google your name, your email address, your profile picture and an account identifier. This information is used only to create your account and sign you in.
google.p2: If you enable synchronization with Google Calendar, Lien Parental requests access to a “Lien Parental” calendar that it creates for you (or, if you choose, to the events of your primary calendar). This access is used only to copy, edit or delete there the events you create in Lien Parental. Lien Parental does not read your other events, does not keep them and does not use them for any other purpose. You can stop synchronization at any time from the calendar settings or from your Google account; the access tokens are then revoked and deleted.
google.p3: Lien Parental’s use and transfer to any other app of information received from Google APIs will adhere to the <link>Google API Services User Data Policy</link>, including the Limited Use requirements. This data is never sold, used for advertising or used to train artificial intelligence models, and no one on the team reads it, except at your request, for legal obligations or for security reasons.

security.title: Encryption and security
security.p1: Exchanges are encrypted in transit (HTTPS/TLS). Data is stored encrypted at rest by our database host (AES-256), and children’s medical information is additionally encrypted by the application itself (AES-256-GCM). Passwords are hashed by our authentication service (bcrypt) and the vault code is hashed (scrypt): they are never stored in plain text. Google access tokens are encrypted. Database backups are encrypted.

retention.title: Retention period
retention.p1: Account data is kept for as long as you use the service, then for a period of three (3) years after the last active sign-in, for evidentiary purposes and in accordance with legal requirements. Documents with evidentiary value uploaded to the vault may be kept longer at your express request.

rights.title: Rights and right to be forgotten
rights.p1: In accordance with articles 15 to 22 of the GDPR, you have the right of access, rectification, erasure (“right to be forgotten”), restriction, portability and objection. These rights can be exercised directly from your “profile” area, or by email to dpo@lienparental.fr. You can also lodge a complaint with the CNIL, the French data protection authority (www.cnil.fr).

install.metaDescription: Add Lien Parental to the home screen of your iPhone or Android phone in a few seconds.

share.title: Open the share menu
share.text: Tap the Share button <share></share> at the bottom of Safari.
share.more: It’s the square with an arrow pointing up, in the middle of the bottom bar. If the bar is hidden, tap the bottom of the screen to bring it back. On iPad, the button is at the top right. If you use another browser, open this page in Safari.

scroll.title: Scroll through the options
scroll.text: Swipe up to show the full list of actions.
scroll.more: The menu opens from the bottom of the screen. The actions are below the row of app icons: keep scrolling until you see “Add to Home Screen”.

add.title: Add to the Home Screen
add.more: The option has a square with a “+” next to it. If it doesn’t appear, tap “Edit Actions” at the very bottom of the list to add it.

confirm.title: Confirm
confirm.more: You can change the displayed name before confirming. The Lien Parental icon then appears on your Home Screen: tap it to open the app in full screen.

menu.title: Open the menu
menu.text: Tap the <dots></dots> button at the top right of Chrome.
menu.more: These are the three vertical dots, to the right of the address bar. With another browser (Samsung Internet, Firefox), open its main menu: the option has a similar name.

add.title: Select “Add to Home screen”
add.text: Tap this option in the menu.
add.more: Depending on your version of Chrome, it may be called “Install app”. Scroll through the menu if you don’t see it right away.

confirm.title: Confirm
confirm.more: A confirmation window opens. The button may also be called “Install”. Android may then let you place the icon yourself on the home screen.

done.title: The app has been added
done.text: Find Lien Parental on your home screen.
done.more: The icon appears on the home screen or in your app list. Tap it to open Lien Parental in full screen, like a regular app.
